provenance.event: SWAT4HCLS 2025 BioHackathon, genomic variation RDF representations
provenance.sourceFormat: Google Sheets workbook, one sheet per model plus a summary sheet
provenance.vrsVersionNote: The BioHackathon sheets were curated against GA4GH VRS 1.2/1.3 and use the vrs1: prefix. vcf-core itself targets VRS 2.0 (vrs:); Genotype, Haplotype, SequenceInterval, ChromosomeLocation, Text, Residue, Feature, Gene and UtilityVariation were removed in 2.0.
provenance.verificationNote: Every transcribed row was diffed against the live workbook on 2026-09-08: 116 mappings (HERO 25, Med2RDF 50, Gigwa 30, SemBeacon 11), no discrepancies beyond the documented CURIE and formatting normalisations.
provenance.whyMirrored: The workbook is the authoritative source but is not a citable, versioned or content-addressable artifact: it can be edited or unshared without notice and has no pinnable revision. The upstream paper repository publishes no mapping data, and the SSSOM conversion its text refers to was never released. This transcription is therefore kept in-repo, with the source URLs above recorded per set.
